<translate>
'''Namekian Warriors''' are the defenders of the Namekian villages on [[Special:MyLanguage/Namek|Planet Namek]]. They don't trade: they guard their village, fly, and fight the hostile mobs that come near.
</translate>

<translate>
== Where to find them ==

Namekian Warriors are placed in the Namekian villages, Ajissa-style in the Ajissa Plains and Sacred-style in the Sacred Land, and the villages keep spawning a few more inside their walls.
</translate>

<translate>
== Behavior ==

Warriors use the village alert and defend behavior: they attack hostile mobs with about 15 melee damage and have 200 health. They can fly, and they return to their village when they wander off.

They are the main target of the [[Special:MyLanguage/Gete Robot|Gete Robots]] that march on the villages.
</translate>
